blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tots Carlos remains defiant that Creamline can secure a semifinal berth despite back-to-back losses in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. The Cool Smashers fell short of completing a comeback against Choco Mucho, 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13, on Thursday night at Smart Araneta Coliseum. With Creamline now at 4-2 but still in second place, Carlos remains optimistic despite Creamline’s tough assignments against semifinal-bound Nxled on Tuesday and Farm Fresh on Nov. 21, both at Philsports Arena. “Coach reminded us that everything is still within our control.
